name: CrossFit Uncommon
address: 208 W Powell Ln, Austin, TX 78753, USA

plans.name: CrossFit
plans.note: Unlimited CrossFit group classes plus Open Gym, goal reviews, nutrition education and InBody scans. Billed every 4 weeks on a rolling no-contract cycle.

sourcing_notes: The rate card states a single price per tier and names no enrollment or annual fee anywhere on the page. Both are recorded as sourced zeros rather than as unknowns, on the CorePower precedent.

The page states the membership runs on "a 4-week no contract rolling cycle", so the $225 is billed 13 times a year rather than 12. The monthly equivalent shown across the site is normalized from that, never from treating $225 as a calendar month.

Semi-private ($400–$1,200) and personal training ($400–$2,500) are quoted as ranges with "various options available" and are one-to-one or small-group coaching. They are add-ons rather than the product being priced, so no figure is carried from them.
A drop-in and a week pass exist but the page says "contact us" rather than publishing a rate, so no day-pass figure is carried.
